summary.text: Year beasts are special fierce beasts of the River of Time. They eat year Gu and range from desolate to immemorial desolate battle strength.

claims.text: While studying Hei Fan’s sealed year Gu and Years Flow Like Water, Fang Yuan records year beasts as a type of special fierce beast. They are rare even in the five regions and nine heavens, yet commonly seen in the River of Time. That river is the paradise of time path Gu worms, and year beasts are among the lifeforms there that eat year Gu as food.
In terms of battle strength, year beasts exist at desolate beast, ancient desolate beast, and immemorial desolate beast levels.

The higher the rank of the year Gu, the more year beasts are attracted to hunt it. Immortal level year Gu can lure year beasts even when placed inside an immortal aperture, because ordinary immortal apertures hold a tributary of the River of Time; year beasts smell the Gu, travel the tributary from the River of Time, and appear in the aperture. Years Flow Like Water, which can endlessly produce year Gu, has hundreds or thousands of times as much attraction as immortal level year Gu, which is why Hei Fan sealed both Gu when laying his true inheritance.

Hei Fan’s true inheritance states there are twelve different forms of year beasts. When Fang Yuan first uses year beast summoning in the Lang Ya eagle hound fight, the beast that answers is a chicken year beast, hill-sized, with no Immortal Gu of its own and a physical constitution stronger than the ancient eagle hound it faces. Year beasts remain very rare even inside the River of Time.
The summoning killer move that baits them with year Gu scent is covered on Year Beast Summoning.

Normal year beasts can be enslaved, but ones filled with heaven’s will cannot be, and if anyone could do it at all they would have to be an incredible expert with extraordinary methods. Those heaven’s will year beasts come from Thousand Transformations Ancestor’s myriad tribulation, formed from his own flesh rather than born wild, and he sells them in treasure yellow heaven because they are his enemies and he cannot use them.

Year beasts carry time path dao marks. If Golden Age Platform wantonly extracts their strength, they can die and those dao marks are destroyed, leaving corpses of no value. The higher their rank, the larger their appetite, and their food remains year Gu. Strength among immemorial year beasts differs clearly, compared in the text to the spread among rank eight Gu Immortals.

Besides year beasts, the River of Time holds other lifeforms such as day beasts, month beasts, and dark web spiders. On one River of Time stretch Fang Yuan ignores those other kinds while taking in year beasts.
